About Me

My name is Sapir, and I'm a Computer Science undergraduate student
at Holon Institute of Technology (HIT). I have Successfully completed professional training in Software Quality Assurance and Automation at The Automation College, Gal Matalon.

My passion for QA comes from a genuine curiosity about how software works, exploring different test scenarios, and identifying potential defects that can impact software quality and user experience.
I enjoy combining analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail to understand complex systems, identify issues, and contribute to the development of reliable, high-quality products.

I'm eager to take the next step in my professional journey, apply my knowledge in a real-world environment, and gain hands-on experience as part of a collaborative team.
Driven by ambition, a proactive mindset, and a commitment to continuous learning.
I'm looking for an opportunity to contribute, develop my technical skills, and build a meaningful,
long-term career in the tech industry.
